title: Quietly crunchy Turkish blueberries Skewers
description: A solo dinner Turkish dish featuring blueberries, with a briny and crunchy texture, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quiet evening meal.

ingredients.name: wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes before use to prevent them from burning during cooking.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, sumac, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the fresh blueberries to the marinade and gently toss to coat, being careful not to bruise the blueberries.
Thread a few blueberries onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each blueberry.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat and brush with a small amount of olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are slightly caramelized and crunchy.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
Serve the skewers immediately, with a side of quinoa or bulgur for a filling dinner.
Deglaze the grill pan with a small amount of water to remove any remaining marinade and blueberry juice.
